title: Daniel Gale, Book Fairies Connect for Book Drive - NewsBreak
text:
By Press Release ,
1 days ago Daniel Gale Sotheby’s International Realty and The Daniel Gale Foundation have launched a community book drive in partnership with The Book Fairies , a nonprofit organization that helps close literacy gaps for children and families across Long Island and the New York City metropolitan area. The initiative kicked off earlier this week on March 2, 2026, with donation sites established at Daniel Gale Sotheby’s International Realty offices region wide.
This long-term drive will collect new and gently used children’s books, young adult titles, and family-oriented reading materials to be distributed through The Book Fairies’ programs — which source and redistribute books to schools, classroom and home libraries, community centers, shelters, and other partners that serve high-need neighborhoods on Long Island and in New York City. The Book Fairies’ model removes financial and access barriers so that every child has equitable opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive through reading.
“Reading unlocks opportunity, inspires curiosity, and builds confidence in children of all ages,” said Deirdre O’Connell, Chief Executive Officerof Daniel Gale Sotheby’s International Realty. “We are honored to partner with The Book Fairies to help ensure more children have access to the books they deserve, not just for school, but for a lifetime of learning, discovery, and joy.”
The partnership draws on The Book Fairies’ deep expertise in literacy outreach; according to their mission, the organization has become one of the region’s leading book donation advocates by placing donated books directly into the hands of children where they are needed most. Their ongoing work helps nurture a love of reading and supports educators and community partners in building vibrant, accessible book collections.
Eileen Minogue, Executive Directorof The Book Fairies, noted the importance of community collaboration in expanding literacy: “We know that every child should have access to books and the joy of reading, yet many face barriers to getting them. Through this partnership with Daniel Gale Sotheby’s International Realty and The Daniel Gale Foundation, we can help more families build home libraries and give children the tools they need to succeed.”
Details:
Where: Collection bins at participating Daniel Gale Sotheby’s International Realty offices across Long Island and New York City What to Donate: New or gently used books appropriate for children and families, including picture books, early readers, chapter books, and young adult titles Distribution: All donated books will be redistributed through The Book Fairies’ programs to schools and community partners serving under-resourced areas
